description: Salesforce connector (read-only). Surfaces a tenant's Opportunities as salesforce:opportunity items in the local index via the SOQL query API — GET <instance_url>/services/data/v60.0/query?q=<SOQL> over the Opportunity sObject — capturing each opportunity's name, stage, amount, close date, probability, type, and won/closed flags. Three-legged OAuth auth (Authorization: Bearer <token>; short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the authorization-code-with-PKCE flow; never logged). The per-tenant API host (instance_url) is discovered at OAuth time and injected at spawn; the only fixed host declared here is login.salesforce.com (the authorize/token host) — the instance host is added to the sandbox manifest at spawn via the lazy-mesh extra-hosts path. SOQL query responses page via { records, done, nextRecordsUrl }, walked forward per cycle, page-capped. Read-only — hitlRequired is intentionally empty. Sparse structured opportunity metadata.
author: Nimbus
